map.叠加顺序会影响最终价吗？: Does the Stacking Order Affect the Final Price?
map.会。比例折扣与满减组合时，「先比例后满减」通常更优惠（满减门槛更易达到）；「先满: Yes. When a percentage discount and a threshold discount are combined, "percentage first, then threshold" is usually better (the threshold is easier to reach); in the reverse order the threshold discount itself gets discounted. When designing a promotion, make the order explicit and cost it out.
